extracted.intended_audience: grant applicants and institutional grants administrators preparing NIH Research & Related budgets and budget justifications (including prime and subaward organizations)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the NIH Research & Related budget and budget justification (including subaward/consortium budgets) with required line-item sections, personnel effort reporting, equipment thresholds, indirect/fringe calculations, and attachment rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section A: Senior/Key Person
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION A. Senior/Key Person fields: Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary ($), Cal. Months, Acad. Months, Sum. Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each senior/key person with name, project role, salary basis, effort reported in calendar/academic/sum months, requested salary and fringe; include 'Total Funds Requested for all Senior/Key Persons in the attached file' and attach additional senior/key person information as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section B: Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION B. Other Personnel fields: Number of Personnel, Project Role, Cal. Months, Acad. Months, Sum. Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits, Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out other personnel by category (e.g., PostDoctoralAssociates, GraduateStudents, StaffScientistII, ResearchAssociateII, secretarial/clerical) with counts and months; provide totals for number of other personnel and total salary/wages and fringe benefits (A + B).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section C: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION C. Equipment: Description; List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000; EquipmentItem* FundsRequested($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize equipment purchases, and for each item over $5,000 provide a description and dollar amount; include a total funds requested for all equipment listed and attach an equipment file if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section D: Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION D. Travel: separate Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs; FundsRequested($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide itemized domestic and foreign travel costs; indicate totals and include travel justification in the budget justification attachment (e.g., conference travel for PI and scientist).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section E: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs: Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other; Number of Participants/Trainees; FundsRequested($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List participant/trainee cost categories and number of participants/trainees, and provide totals for participant/trainee support costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section F: Other Direct Costs (detailed categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET - SECTION F. Other Direct Costs include: 1. Materials and Supplies; 2. Publication Costs; 3. Consultant Services; 4. ADP/Computer Services; 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; 7. Alterations and Renovations; (8-10 additional lines available).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item amounts for each other direct cost category; include shipping costs, controls, consumables, consultant costs, subaward contractual costs, and any facility/user fees; sum to 'Total Other Direct Costs.'

rubrics_metrics.name: G: Direct Costs (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs = Total Direct Costs (A thru F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate and report the sum of Sections A through F as the total direct costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: H: Indirect Costs (F&A) and Cognizant Agency
rubrics_metrics.description: H. Indirect Costs: Indirect Cost Type; Indirect Cost Rate (%); Indirect Cost Base ($); MTDCTotalIndirectCosts; Cognizant Federal Agency (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the institution's federally negotiated F&A/indirect cost rate to the appropriate base (e.g., Modified Total Direct Costs - MTDC); report the rate, base, and resulting indirect cost amount; provide the cognizant federal agency contact (example shown: DHHS, DCA Western Field Office, Arif Karim, 415-437-7820).

rubrics_metrics.name: I: Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs = Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum total direct costs (G) and total indirect costs (H) and report the combined total for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: J: Fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicable, include any fee amount requested and report it in the designated J. Fee field.

rubrics_metrics.name: K: Budget Justification attachment rules
rubrics_metrics.description: K. * Budget Justification: Only attach one file. FileName and MimeType fields are provided for the budget justification attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a single budget justification PDF (or declared mimeType) that explains personnel roles and percent effort, materials and supplies, travel, subcontractor/subaward roles, equipment purchases, fringe and F&A rates, and other direct cost details (examples shown in the document include detailed personnel descriptions and percent effort for Immunetics and subaward organizations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward / Consortium budget requirements and structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Subaward/Consortium budgets must provide organizational DUNS, Budget Type, Organization name, Start Date, End Date, Budget Period, and include Sections A-F (Senior/Key Person; Other Personnel; Equipment; Travel; Participant/Trainee Support; Other Direct Costs) and Sections F-K (Other Direct Costs through Budget Justification) for each subaward.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each subaward should submit its own Research & Related budget per budget period with the same sectioned format, list personnel and effort, itemize equipment and other costs, provide indirect costs or indicate 'None' where applicable, attach a subaward-specific budget justification file, and include cumulative subtotals; example pages show Subaward 1, Subaward 2, Subaward 3 with repeated section headings and attachment fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report personnel effort using calendar/academic months and percent effort
rubrics_metrics.description: Personnel effort must be shown in calendar months, academic months, or sum months (and example percent effort values are shown such as 0.60 (calendar months) corresponding to 5% effort or 60% effort entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each person report the number of months and percent effort (or requested salary corresponding to that effort); examples in the justification text show roles listed with percent effort (e.g., 'Patricia Garrett, Ph.D., 60% effort (7.2 cm)') and calendar-month equivalents; include totals and ensure consistency between effort, salary requested, and fringe calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment itemization threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: For equipment, list items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any individual equipment item over $5,000 must be described and priced separately in Section C; include totals for equipment and attach additional equipment documentation if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of approved fringe and indirect (F&A) rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Fringe benefits and indirect costs must be calculated using institutionally/federally approved rates (e.g., 'Fringe benefits are calculated at the rate of ... as approved by NIH DFAS' and 'Indirect costs are charged at Immunetics’ DFAS-approved F&A rate of ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the actual fringe and F&A rates used, reference the approving office when applicable (DFAS or cognizant federal agency), and apply those negotiated rates to the appropriate salary/modified direct cost bases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modified Total Direct Costs (MTDC) base for indirect calculations
rubrics_metrics.description: Modified Total Direct Costs (MTDC) / Modified Total Direct Cost is used as the indirect cost base and is referenced repeatedly in the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and report the MTDC amount used as the base for F&A calculations; ensure MTDC is computed according to agency rules and documented on the budget form where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative budget reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Cumulative Budget: provide totals for Sections A (Senior/Key Person), B (Other Personnel), C (Equipment), D (Travel), E (Participant/Trainee Support Costs), F (Other Direct Costs), and totals for salary/wages and fringe benefits and overall totals ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cumulative totals across budget periods and subawards, showing aggregated numbers for personnel, equipment, travel, and other cost categories as illustrated on the 'Cumulative Budget' pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget justification narrative should describe personnel roles and responsibilities, percent effort, relevant experience/qualifications, tasks to be performed, materials and supplies to be purchased, travel justification, shipping/sample costs, subcontractor responsibilities, fringe and indirect cost rationale, and any special compliance or QA duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The example 'BUDGET JUSTIFICATION – IMMUNETICS' shows expected content: detailed descriptions of PI and key personnel roles, percent effort, specific laboratory tasks, quality assurance roles, consortium partner tasks (e.g., Diagnostic Innovations developing conjugates), shipping reimbursement, and statements of 'None' for equipment when no equipment requested; include similar level of detail for each budget line.
